top_signals.title: Reaching 2% Inflation Will Be Challenging for the Fed, Feroli Says
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chief US Economist Mike Feroli says it will be a challenge for the Federal Reserve to get inflation back down below its target of 2%. Feroli says he was surprised that Fed Governor Lisa Cook called on the FOMC to raise rates by a quarter percentage point. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary:
It’s a strange time for the defense technology sector. Despite the headlines of record capital, valuations, and defense budgets, there is a growing unease among investors and leadership teams. Production contracts remain as elusive as ever, and a generation of startups is struggling to extend their runways across the valley of death, risking not just those businesses but capital flight from the broader sector.
